parole.significato: mamaliga, cornmeal mush, polenta (a porridge-like dish made of coarse maize-meal)
parole.testo: Uncertain. Possibly a substrate word or an expressive creation based on mamă or Latin mamilla (representing the idea of nourishment) + -ică. Alternately, it can be inherited from Latin [Term?], akin to Italian meliga (“maize, sorghum”), from Latin milium (“millet”).
